answerOptions.text: 368 CURRENT AFFAIRS Basantotsaba, 2019 Organized in Puri State level cultural organisation Daya Jyoti l organised Basantotsaba, 2019 at the Annapurna Theatre and various schools of Puri on 18th March, 2019. The main objective is to promote and l develop values of secularism, nationalism, communal harmony and national integration. Odisha Parba, 2019 Celebrated in Delhi The ‘Odisha Parba, 2019’, a three day-long l mega celebration of Odisha’s culture, tradition, heritage, ethnic cuisine and handlooms and handicrafts, organised in New Delhi on 15th March, 2019. Chief Guest of the ceremony was former President of India, Pranab Mukherjee. This is the 3rd edition of Odisha Parba l after the successful two editions held in New Delhi. People can see glimpses of Odisha’s rich l cultural legacy in the vibrant festival and mouth-watering street foods from classic cities of Odisha like Cuttack, Brahmapur, etc. Anti Tank Missile was Launched On 8th February, 2019, the anti tank l via missile ‘Helina’ was launched helicopter from the integrated test range in Chandipur of Balasore district. The missile was suceessfully test fired. Helina is indigenously designed with a l range between 7-8 kilometres. It will help in strengthening the defence capabilities of the country. Declaration of Provision of Two Child Norm On 8th February, 2019, the Supreme l Court has sought the declaration of the ‘two-child norm’ as a mandatory criterion for government jobs, aids and subsidies. The two-child norm for contesting local l body elections have already been adopted by Odisha along with several other states. Odisha Budget 2019-20 Presented by Finance Minister On 7th February, 2019 Finance Minister of Odisha, Shashi Bhusan Behera presented a welfare, growth, development and investment oriented budget for 2019-20 in the Odisha Legislative Assembly with an ` outlay of 132660 crore, which is about 10.4% more than the Annual Budget, 2018-19. The highlights of the budget are as follows: As the State Executive has launched the l State Food Security Scheme, to cover the unnoticed beneficiaries below National Food Security Act, it has made a provision ` ` of 1028 crore for providing rice at 1 per kg. CURRENT AFFAIRS A sports advanced, with built-in l amenities, is planned in each and every district. World-class satellite stadium will be constructed in districts like Cuttack, Rourkela, Berhampur, Sambalpur and Jeypore. ` Odisha executive sanctions 5 crore to l Shree Jagannath Temple management, Puri for taking over developmental works. Budget estimate for 2019-20 fiscal l estimated at ` 1.32 lakh crore (the vote-on-account) is over 40% of general estimates. Madhu Babu Pension Yojana, state’s old l age pension scheme covering 48 lakh aged, widows, destitutes gets an ` allocation of 2120 crore. Allocation under state’s own rural water l ` supply scheme, BASUDHA is pegged at 2935 crore. Odisha’s financial system is predicted to l grow on the rate of 8.35% in 2018-19 surpassing all India expansion rate of 7.2%. ` Government allocates 400 crore under l ‘Ama Gaon, Ama Bikas’. ` Odisha executive allocates 4461 crore l under Kalia scheme for farmers. KALIA Chhatra Bruti Scholarship Launched On 3rd February, 2019, the Odisha State l Government has launched the KALIA Chhatra Bruti scholarship scheme for the children of farmers. This program is launched with the l mission to provide monetary help to bright students so that they can excel in ` the future. Odisha would spend 10,180 crore over three years until 2020-21 under this scheme. 2300 Years Old Artefacts Found in Odisha Archaeologists have unearthed artifacts l believed to be 2300 year old while carrying out excavation at the Asurgarh Fort in Odisha’s Kalahandi district on 369 20th January, 2019. A nine member team of Archaeological Survey of India led by DB Garnayak excavated the items dating from Mauryan to Kushana period. The present archaeological work reveals a l number of brick structures. Wedge shaped bricks are also noticed in the circular structures. Most of the structures have terracotta tiles with groves and hole for socketing. Other discovered artifacts include, glass l bangle pieces of different designs and colours, sling balls, pestle, iron equipment like small wheel, ring, and arrow head. Odisha CM Hiked Pension under Madhu Babu Pension Yojana Scheme Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik announced l in a video conference on Ama Gaon, Ama Bikash a hike of ` 200 per month in the social security pension under Madhu Babu Pension Yojana (MBPY) on 19th January, 2019. The State Government launched Madhu l Babu Pension Yojana on 1st January, 2008, by merging two pension schemes – Old Age Pension and Odisha Disability Pension Schemes. Objective of this yojana is to providing l financial assistance to the destitute elderly and destitute differently abled persons in the state. Odisha Extended Free Health Services to All Medical Colleges Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik on l 18th January, 2019 announced extension of free health services under Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana to all government medical colleges and hospitals from 1st to February this year. All patients, irrespective of APL or BPL category, will be able to avail of this facility. Besides, all patients will be provided blood l bank facility free of cost. Earlier, the free treatment facilities for all were available at sub-centres in villages and district headquarters hospitals. 370 The BSKY was launched on 15th August l last year. It has received overwhelming response with over 2.25 crore instances of free healthcare service being availed of by the people of the state. Odisha Launched ‘Ama Ghare LED’ Scheme Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik l launched a new scheme Ama Ghare LED in the state on 12th January, 2019. Under the scheme, four numbers of nine l watt LED bulbs will be distributed to each beneficiary registered under National Food Security Act (NFSA) and the State Food Security Scheme (SFSS) free of cost. Around 95 lakh beneficiaries will be l benefitted under this scheme. The State Government will procure 3.80 l crore LED bulbs for distribution among the beneficiaries. Golf Cup 2019 Organised Odisha organised the 14th NAVAYUGA l East Zone Corporate Golf Cup 2019 on 12th-13th January, 2019 at Bhubaneswar. The event was organised by Shri Chandra Sarathi Behera, Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology, Sports and Youth Services of Odisha. Participants from around 25 government l and Corporate Organisations from Eastern Zone participated in the tournament. PM Narendra Modi Visited Odisha Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited l Baripada, in Odisha,where he inaugurated projects worth ` 4500 crore on 5th January, 2019. He dedicated the Balasore-Haldia- l Durgapur section of the IOCL’s Paradip- Haldia-Durgapur LPG pipeline to the nation, which will ensure easy supply of LPG in parts of Odisha and West Bengal. He inaugurated the Multi Modal Logistic l Park at Balasore and six Passport Sewa Kendras. He also unveiled a digital plaque to mark l the commencement of work for conservation and development of Rasika Ray Temple, and excavated structure at ancient Fort Haripurgarh. New Announcement Under Mission Shakti in Odisha Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik l announced interest-free loans of up to ` 3 lakh for 6 lakh Women Self Help Groups (WSHGs) benefitting about 70 lakh women in Odisha. This was announced at the Mission Shakti l convention attended by about 50,000 women on 5th January, 2019. The ‘Mission Shakti’ programme was launched in 2001. Odisha Announced 0 % Interest Loan for SHGs Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik has l announced Zero percent interest loan for Self Help Groups (SHGs) on 5th January, 2019 under the Mission Shakti Scheme of State Government introduced for women’s financial inclusion and development. ` Chief Minister announced 15000 seed l ` money for new SHGs, 3000 to purchase smartphones for digital empowerment and a sum of ` 25 lakh for 338 existing block federations. Mission Shakti was launched in 2001 as a l project aiming economic empowerment of women through Self Help Groups and providing them bank loans at low interest for livelihood opportunities. At present, around 70 lakh women are l working with over 6 lakh SHGs with 5000 crore savings and 2000 crores annual bank exposure. National Children’s Science Congress (NSCS) Inaugurated in Odisha On 27th December, 2018, 26th Session of l NSCS is held in Bhubaneswar. The theme of the session is ‘‘Science, l Technology and Innovation for a Clean, Green and Healthy Nation.’’ CURRENT AFFAIRS New Olive Ridley Nesting Site added by Odisha Forest Department On 26th December, 2018 a new Olive l Ridley Nesting Site is added by Odisha Forest Department in Ganjam district. Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary and l Rushikulya a Rookery Coast in Ganjam district are other main Olive Ridley Nesting Sites. Odisha is home to 50% of the total world l population of Olive Ridley Turtles. Odisha Increased MSP for Oilseeds and Pulses The Odisha government has decided to l procure oilseeds and pulses with increased minimum support price on 23rd December, 2018. Administrative preparedness is in full swing to procure oil seeds and pulses from farmers for the first time in a kharif crop season. A monitoring committee chaired by Chief l Secretary AP Padhi has increased MSP for ` green gram from 5575 per quintal to ` 6975, from ` 5400 to ` 5600 in case of black gram, from ` 5450 to ` 5675 pigeon ` ` peas and 4450 to 4890 peanuts. Since pulses sell at a very low price during l production, the primary agricultural cooperatives will buy oil seeds and pulses by paying Minimum Support Price (MSP) fixed for different produces. ` Odisha Announced 10000 Crore KALIA Scheme Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik on l 21st December, 2018 announced ` 10000 crore scheme for the overall development of farmers in the state. 371 The State Cabinet has approved the l Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (KALIA) Scheme, worth over ` 10000 crore, for the overall development of farmers in Odisha. Odisha Launched Transparency Programmes of Government Schemes Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik on l 4th December, 2018 announced a new programme for transparency and awareness on various government schemes. The programme, the Peoples l Empowerment Enabling Transparency and Accountability (PEETHA) aims to improve transparency in the distribution of individual and social benefits. As part of the initiative, camps will be l organised at the Gram Panchayat level from the 15th to the 20th of each month, beginning December, 2018. Every month, the best Panchayat in each l ` Block will be given 5 lakh for organising PEETHA. Upon completion of the camps, the best Panchayats in each district will be awarded at the District Level. Similarly, Panchayats, Blocks and best l Districts will be awarded with special funds at the State Level. Hockey Men’s World Cup Organised Odisha state organised the Hockey World l Cup for Men. The tournament was held 28th November to 16th December, 2018. It kicked off at Kalinga Stadium at Bhubaneswar. The world cup was participated by 16 l nations and was won by Belgium. 372 Odisha Government Launched Biotechnology Policy, 2018 Odisha government on 15th November, l 2018 announced a new Biotechnology Policy, 2018 to attract investments in the sector at the concluding day of the Make in Odisha Conclave. The development of this sector will be by l forming Public Private Partnership, bio-incubation centres and bi-tech finishing schools. ‘Make in Odisha Conclave 2018’ held Make in Odisha Conclave the flagship l biennial business event of the Government of Odisha inaugurated at the state capital Bhubaneswar on 12th November, 2018. The Conclave was attended by big l business houses of India such as Reliance Industries, Jindal Steels, and Tata Group, etc. Odisha has been growing at 8% per l annum, higher than the national average, and the state is fast becoming an ideal investment destination. After Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu by 2035, Odisha could be the third state to be a $ 1 trillion economy. Odisha Approved Over 25000 crore Investment Plan The Odisha government on 3rd l November, 2018 approved investment ` proposals worth 25,845 crore for setting up six mega manufacturing facilities by Nalco, Hindalco, Vedanta and others. A High-Level Clearance Authority l (HLCA), headed by Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik, gave its nod to the investment proposals of the large scale manufacturing units, which have the potential to create 13,700 jobs in the state. The Odisha government also rolled out l Odisha Aerospace & Defence Manufacturing Policy, 2018, which aims at carrying forward the process of industrialisation through promotion of aerospace and defence manufacturing enterprises, to generate employment opportunities and promote value addition. Saura Jalnidhi Scheme Launched On 3rd November, 2018, the Saura l Jalnidhi Scheme was launched to encourage use of solar energy in irrigation by farmers. Farmer will get 90% subsidy and 5,000 l solar pumps under this scheme. This scheme cover those farmers who have l valid farmer identity cards and have minimum 0.5 acres of agriculture land. Odisha Launched Disaster Alert System on Its Coast The Odisha government on 30th October, l 2018 launched the much-awaited Early Warning Dissemination System (EWDS), the first-of-its-kind technology in India, to simultaneously warn coastal communities and fishermen about incoming cyclone and tsunami through siren towers. Sirens will go off from 122 towers installed l along the 480 km long coast of the state if a button is pressed in the state emergency centre in Bhubaneswar. The innovative warning system would alert l people about disasters. Fishermen fishing in via deep sea can also be reached mass SMS on their mobile phones through EWDS. The EWDS, a collaborative effort of the l Central and State Governments, has been implemented under the assistance of World Bank. It comprises technologies such as l satellite-based mobile data voice terminals, digital mobile radio, mass messaging system and universal communication interface. CURRENT AFFAIRS Odia University to be Opened in Odisha Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik on l 10th October, 2018 laid the foundation stone of Odia University in Puri district. The ground-breaking ceremony marked l the 141st birth anniversary of Utkalamani Gopabandhu Das, a renowned poet, essayist and social activist born in 1877 in Puri. The university aims to promote Odia language across the country. It will offer post-graduate courses in Odia language and literature and facilitate research on different aspects of the language. Two New IISERs at Tirupati and Berhampur On 10th October, 2018, proposal l approved was by Union Cabinet for establishment and operationalisation of two New IISERs at Tirupati and Berhampur. Indian Institutes of Science Education and l Research (IISER) will provide top quality science education at undergraduate and post-graduate land, etc. It will be constructed by December, 2021. l Nirman Kusuma Programme On 6th October 2018, Odisha l Government launched Nirman Kusume Programme for providing financial assistance to the children of construction workers for their technical education in the state. ` ITI student will get 23600 and l Diploma student will get ` 26,300 per annum. 373 Odisha Police to Use Drones to Monitor Maoist-Affected Areas Odisha Director General of Police (DGP) l Rajendra Prasad Sharma informed on 24th September, 2018 that the state police will procure drone cameras for the surveillance of severely Naxal-affected districts to augment security and to watch the movement of Maoists in Malkangiri and Koraput districts. With this, Odisha officially became first l Indian state to use drones for surveillance purposes on naxalites and other extremist groups. India’s First Coal Gasification Fertilizer Plant to Come up in Talcher, Odisha On 22nd September, 2018, India’s first coal l Gasification fertilizer plant was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Plant will be developed by Talcher l Fertilizers Limited (TFL). It is a joint venture of GAIL, CIL, RCFL and FCIL. Plant will have capacity of producing 1.27 l million. Metric tonnes per annum of Neem coated prilled urea. Jharsuguda Airport in Odisha is Inaugurated by Prime Minister On 22nd September, aA new airport in l Power Jharsuguda, also known as the House of Odisha inaugurated. was UDAN flight on Jharsuguda–Raipur sector l is also flagged off. Jharsuguda to be the second airport of l Odisha after Bhubaneswar to become operational. Odisha to Give Skill Training and Education to Surrendered Maoists The Odisha government on 3th August, l 2018 has decided to facilitate skill development training to all those people who were former Maoists in state-run centres in Maoist-affected districts. It is a part of State Government’s scheme to bring Red Rebels into mainstreams. 374 The State Government has ordered the l Director Technical Education and Training (DTET) to relax the requisite educational qualification to facilitate the training of former Maoists in state-run Skill Development Centres (SDCs) and Industrial Training Institutes (ITI). Green Mahanadi Mission in Odisha Green Mahanadi Mission is launched l by the Odisha government on 26th July, 2018. A total of two crore saplings will be planted on the banks of the Mahanadi, Tel and Ib rivers under the mission. The plantation drive was being carried out l in as many as 1303 villages spread over 15 districts situated on both sides of the Mahanadi river. Green Mahanadi Mission Launched by Odisha Government On 24th July, 2018, Odisha Government l launched Green Mahanadi Misssion. It is a plantation drive under which 2 crore saplings will be planted along Mahanadi river and its tributaries. Main objective of the mission is to stop soil l erosion on river banks and recharge the ground water reserve. It will be implemented jointly by States l Department of Forest, Horticulture and Watershed Development. Odisha Government to Collaborate with RIMES for Disaster Management On 29th June, 2018, Odisha Government l signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System (RIMES). It will help in enhancing preparedness for management of hazards in state. Partnership between Odisha State Disaster l Mitigation Authority (OSDMA) and RIMES. In field of drought monitoring and early l warning for different natural disasters. RIMES is an intergovernmental body l registered under United Nations. Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana Launched On 31st May, 2018, Odisha Government l launched Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana. This scheme provides ` 2 lakh per annum l health insurance cover. It is named after Gopalbandhu Das l (1877-1928), a prominent social worker, reformer, political activist, journalist, poet and essayist of Odisha. NIC Sets up Cloud-enabled National Data Centre in Bhubaneswar On 25th May, 2018 National Informatics l Centre (NIC) was set up in Bhubaneswar. It will offer round-the-clock operations l with secure hosting for e-governance applications of ministeries and departments. Its fourth cloud-enabled National Data l Centre of NIC after Delhi, Hyderabad and Pune. World’s Second Oldest Rock Discovered in Odisha On 10th May, 2018, scientists have l discovered world’s second oldest grain of magmatic zircon (a mineral that contains traces of radioactive isotopes) from Champua from Singhbhum rock sample in Odisha Kendujhar district. Estimated 4240 million years old. l The oldest zircon older than this discovery l was found in Jack Hill, Western Australia. Commemorative Coins Released by President for Nabakalebara Festival On 18th March, 2018, President Ram l Nath Kovind has released ` ` 1000 and 10 commemorative coins. Released to mark the festival which is a l symbolic recreation of sibling deities–Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra. Nabakalebara is an ancient ritual that is l observed in the Shri Jagannath temple at Puri. CURRENT AFFAIRS Odisha Government Launches Ama Gaon, Ama Vikas Programme On 4th March, 2018, Odisha Government l launched AmaGaon, Ama Vikas Programme. It is a programme to reach out to people in rural areas and involve themselves in developmental activities. Under this programme, people can directly l send their grievances to Chief Minister’s Office (CMO) of Secretariat in Bhubaneswar through Wi-Fi enabled latest technology video wall vans. Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik flagged off l mobile video vans that will move across the state of highlight various welfare schemes. India’s First Automatic Early Warning Dissemination System to Came up in Odisha It will be commissioned by March, 2018 in l Odisha. Aims to establish fool-proof communication l system to address existing gaps in disseminating disaster warning up to community level. Project is being implemented under National l Cyclone Risk Mitigation Project with World Bank’s help. Loud sirens will be installed at 12 locations in l six coastal districts to alert people in event of occurrence of natural disasters like a tsunami or a cyclone. Khushi Scheme Launched in Odisha On 26th February, 2018, Chief Minister of l Odisha launched Khushi scheme. It aims to provide good menstrual hygiene care to women of the state. Government will provide free sanitary l napkins to 17 lakh girls studying in classes 6 to 12 in government and government aided school under this scheme. State is going to invest 70 crore rupees per l year for this scheme. 375 Odisha Won Geospatial World Excellence Award 2018 On 31st January, 2018 Odisha won l Geospatial World Excellence Award 2018 for successful IT application for tracking of mineral production, dispatch and value accrued on real-time basis through its i3MS web based software. i3MS is GPS-linked web based l software is designed by scientists of Odisha Space Applications Centre (ORSAC), Bhubaneswar. The system has enabled for first time in India to fix GPS device on large number of moving objects in the mining sector. It also integrated with Regional l Transport Office (RTO), Indian Railways, Commercial Tax Department, Ports and Treasury. Geospatial World Excellence Awards is l internationally acclaimed private award that recognises exemplary innovations and practices in global geospatial industry. Mangalajodi Ecotourism Trust of Odisha Wins UNWTO Award On 18th January, 2018, United l Nations World Tourism Organisation Award (UNWTO) for Innovation in Tourism Enterprise at 14th UNWTO Awards ceremony is held in Madrid, Spain. Mangalajodi business model is both l economically viable and environmentally sustainable based on principles of community ownership and ecotourism. Mangalajodi ecotourism Trust is l community owned and venture promoted by RBS Foundation India and Indian Grameen Services on banks of Chilika lake in Odisha. 376 Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana On 17th January, 2018, Mukhyamantri Kalakar l financial assistance to the literature and cultural ` Monthly financial assistance of 1200 to literature l provided by State Government.
